entities.summary: Manuel David Mendes is an Angolan lawyer, human rights activist and politician. He is one of the best-known persons of the Angolan civil society, and is also known as "advocate of the poor" because of his opposition to government corruption. Among other things, Mendes directs the Angolan human rights NGO Mãos Livres and due to this is sued by the Angolan government in various corruption cases.
